jīna: Jīna [pp. of jīyati] diminished, wasted, deprived of (with acc. or abl.) 잃은; with acc.: J III.153, 223, 335; V.99 (atthaṁ: 소유물을 빼앗긴; Com. parihīna vinaṭṭha). -- with abl.: J V.401 (read jīnā dhanā).
jīyati:
Jīyati [Pass. of ji, cp. Sk. jyāti & jīryate] 줄어들다, 빼앗기다, 잃다 (cp. jayati, jāni); 쇠퇴하다; 늘게 되다 (cp. jarati, jiṇṇa) jīyasi J V.100; jīyanti J III.336 (dhanā); jīyittha S I.54; J I.468; mā jīyi ~을 빼앗지 마라 (ratiṁ) J IV.107. Koci kvaci na jīyati mīyati (cp. jāyati) D II.30; cakkhūni jīyare 눈은 힘을 잃을 것이다 J VI.528 (=jīyissanti); grd. jeyya: see ajeyya2. Cp. parijīyati. Sometimes spelt jiyy°: jiyyati J VI.150; jiyyāma J II.75 (we lose= parihāyāma). Pp. jīna, q.
v.
jīraka: Jīraka 1 [Vedic jīra, lively, alert, cp. jīvati & Gr. diero/s, Lat. viridis] digestion, in ajīrakena by want or lack of digestion J II.181. See ajīraka.
Jīraka 2 cummin--seed Miln 63; J I.244; II.363; VvA 186.
jīraṇa: Jīraṇa (nt.) [fr. jīr] decaying, getting old Dhtp 252.
jīraṇatā: Jīraṇatā (f.) [n. abstr. of jīr=jar, see jarati; cp. jarā & jiṇṇatā] the state of being decayed or aged, old age, decay, decrepitude M I.49; S II.2; Nd2 252=Dhs 644; PvA 149.
jīrati: Jīrati & Jīrayati [Caus. of jarati] 1. to destroy, bring to ruin, injure, hurt Vin I.237 (jīrati); J V.501 (v. l. BB. For jarayetha, Com. vināseyya)=VI.375; PvA 57. <-> 2. (cp. jīyati) to get old A III.54 (jarā--dhammaṁ mā jīri "old age may not get old," or "the law of decay may not work"); Vism 235 (where id. p. D II.30 reads jīyati); DhA I.11 (cakkhūni jīranti). -- 3. (intrs.) to be digested Vism 101.
jīrayati: Jīrati & Jīrayati [Caus. of jarati] 1. to destroy, bring to ruin, injure, hurt Vin I.237 (jīrati); J V.501 (v. l. BB. For jarayetha, Com. vināseyya)=VI.375; PvA 57. <-> 2. (cp. jīyati) to get old A III.54 (jarā--dhammaṁ mā jīri "old age may not get old," or "the law of decay may not work"); Vism 235 (where id. p. D II.30 reads jīyati); DhA I.11 (cakkhūni jīranti). -- 3. (intrs.) to be digested Vism 101.
jīreti: Jīreti & Jīrāpeti [Verbal formation from jīra1] to work out, to digest J I.238, 274 (jīreti); DhA I.171. Appl. to bhati, wages: bhatiṁ ajīrāpetva not working off the w. J II.309, 381; jīrāpeti as "destroy" at ThA 269 in expln of nijjareti (+vināseti).
jīrāpeti: Jīreti & Jīrāpeti [Verbal formation from jīra1] to work out, to digest J I.238, 274 (jīreti); DhA I.171. Appl. to bhati, wages: bhatiṁ ajīrāpetva not working off the w. J II.309, 381; jīrāpeti as "destroy" at ThA 269 in expln of nijjareti (+vināseti).
jīva: Jīva1 (adj.--n.) [Sk. jīva, Idg. *gṷīṷos=Gr. bi/oQ, Lat. vīvus, Goth. quius, Ohg. queck, E. quick, Lith. gyvas] 1. 혼 Sabbe jīvā 모든 영혼, sattā pāṇā bhūta 와 함께 열거, Gosāla 의 추종자들에 의해 사용된 방언에서 D I.53 (=DA I.161 jīvasannī). "taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīraṁ udāhu aññaṁ j. aññaṁ s." (육신이 영혼인가 혹은 육신이 다르고 영혼은 또 다른 것인가?) see D I.157, 188; II.333, 336, 339; S IV.392 sq.; M I.157, 426 sq.; A II.41. -- Also in this sense at Miln 30, 54, 86. -- Vin IV.34; S III.215, 258 sq.; IV.286; V.418; A V.31, 186, 193. -- 2. 삶, in yāvajīvaṁ 삶이 지속되는 한, 살아가는 동안에, 그의 생애 동안 D III.133; Vin I.201; Dh 64; J II.155; PvA 76. --gāhaṁ (adv.) 살아 있는 것을 취한, in phrase j.° gaṇhāti or gaṇhāpeti S I.84; J I.180; II.404; cp. karamara; --loka 생물의 창조 J III.394; --sūla "삶의 꼬챙이," 사형 집행의 창J II.443; --sokin (=sokajīvin) 슬픈 삶을 이어가는 J VI.509.
Jīva2 (nt.) jīvaka 새의 음조 Sum. V. on D III.201.
jīvaka: Jīvaka (adj.)=jīva, in bandhu° 식물의 이름 VvA 43. -- f. °ikā q. v.
jīvaṃjīvaka: Jīvaṁ-jīvaka (m. onom.) 새의 이름, jīvaṁ jīva 라고 지저귀는 일종의 꿩(혹은 자고새?), D III.201; J V.406, 416; VI.276, 538 [Fausböll 는 모든 자따까 구절에서 jīvajīvaka 라고 읽었고. Speyer는 AvŚ II.227 jīvañjīvaka로 읽었다]. 이렇게 비교해볼 때 Jain 의 구절 jīvaṁjīveṇa gacchaï jīvaṁjīveṇaṁ ciṭṭhaï, Weber Bhagavatī pp. 289, 290, 은 의혹이 가는 번역이다 ("그는 삶을 살아간다"? or " j. 새처럼 간다"?).

Jīvaṁ-jīvaka (m. onom.) 새의 이름, jīvaṁ jīva 라고 지저귀는 일종의 꿩(혹은 자고새?), D III.201; J V.406, 416; VI.276, 538 [Fausböll 는 모든 자따까 구절에서 jīvajīvaka 라고 읽었고. Speyer는 AvŚ II.227 jīvañjīvaka로 읽었다]. 이렇게 비교해볼 때 Jain 의 구절 jīvaṁjīveṇa gacchaï jīvaṁjīveṇaṁ ciṭṭhaï, Weber Bhagavatī pp. 289, 290, 은 의혹이 가는 번역이다 ("그는 삶을 살아간다"? or " j. 새처럼 간다"?).
jīvati: Jīvati [Vedic jīvati, cp. jinoti (jinvati); Dhtp 282: pāṇadhāraṇe *gQei̯ē =Gr. bi/omai & zw/w, zh_n; Lat. vīvo: Goth. ga--quiunan; Mhg. quicken, cp. E. quicken] 살다, 살아있다, ~으로 살다, ~으로 연명하다(c. instr. or nissāya). Imper. pres. jīva Sn 427, very freq. with ciraṁ 오래 살다. . ., 인사와 감사로. ciraṁ jīva J VI.337; c. jīvāhi Sn 1029; Pv II.333; c. jīvantu Pv I.55; -- pot. jīve Sn 440, 589; Dh 110; -- ppr. jīvaṁ Sn 427, 432; <-> ppr. med. jīvamāna J I.307; PvA 39; -- inf. jīvituṁ J I.263; Dh 123. -- Sn 84 sq., 613 sq., 804; Dh 197; J III.26; IV.137; VI.183 (jīvare); PvA 111.
jīvana: Jīvana (nt.) 생활, 생계수단, 생계 PvA 161. Spelt jīvāna (v. l. jīvino) (adj.) at J III.353 (yācana°).
jīvamānaka: Jīvamānaka (adj.) [ppr. med. of jīvati+ka] 사는, 살아 있는 Vism 194.
jīvikā: Jīvikā (f.) [abstr. fr. jīvaka] 생활, 생계 S III.93; A V.87, 210; J IV.459; Miln 122; SnA 466. Freq. in combn °ṁ kappeti 생계를 찾다 혹은 세우다: J II.209; PvA 40, etc.; °kappaka 생활 수단을 찾은 (c. ger. by) J II.167. Cp. next.
jīvita: Jīvita (nt.) [Vedic jīvita, orig. pp. of jīvati "that which is lived," cp. same formation in Lat. vīta=*vīvita; Gr. bio/th living, sustenace, & di/aita, "diet"] (개인의)삶, 생애, 수명; 생활, 생계 (cp. jīvikā) Vin II.191; S I.42; IV.169, 213; M II.73 (appaṁ); A I.155, 255; III.72; IV.136 (appakaṁ parittaṁ); Sn 181, 440, 574, 577, 931, 1077; Dh 110, 111, 130; J I.222; Pv I.1111 (ittaraṁ); II.67 (vijahati); Dhs 19, 295; Vism 235, 236; Ps II.245; PvA 40. -- jīvitā voropeti 삶을 뺏다, 죽이다 Vin III.73; D III.235; M II.99; A III.146, 436; IV.370 sq.; PvA 67. --āsQ 삶에 대한 욕망 A I.86; --indriya 삶의 기능, 활력 Vin III.73; S V.204; Kvu 8, 10; Miln 56; Dhs 19; Vism 32, 230 (°upaccheda 삶의 파괴), 447 (def.); DhA II.356 (°ṁ upacchindati 삶을 파괴하다); VvA 72; --kkhaya 삶의 분해, 즉, 죽음 J I.222; PvA 95, 111; --dāna "삶의 선물," 생명을 구해준, 목숨을 살려준 J I.167; II.154; --nikanti 삶에 대한 욕망 A IV.48; --parikkhārā (pl.) 삶의 필수품 M I.104 sq.; A III.120; V.211; --pariyādāna 삶의 중지 혹은 소멸 D I.46 (=DA I.128); S II.83; A IV.13; --pariyosāna 삶의 끝, 즉 죽음 J I.256; PvA 73; --mada 삶에의 자긍, 3 madā 아래 열거되어 있다; viz. ārogya, yobbana, j.: 건강, 젊음, 수명 D III.220; A I.146; III.72; --rūpa (adj.) 사는(삶 같은) J II.190; --sankhaya=°khaya Sn 74; Dh 331; Nd2 262 (=°pariyosāna); --hetu (adv.) 삶의 기반 위에서, 삶을 위해 A IV.201, 270
jīvin: Jīvin (adj.) (usually --°) 사는, 삶을 이어가는 (of . . .) S I.42, 61; Sn 88, 181; Dh 164; PvA 27. Cp. dīgha°, dhamma°.
